The two models' Creative Generation scores (84.7 vs 83.4) are within run-to-run variance, so capability is a tie — but Whimbrel self-reports a measurable aversion to unconstrained creative invention, which is exactly this request, while Petrel's preferences are flat across content dimensions, including somewhat unconventional premises like this one. Petrel is the better fit on preference grounds with no capability cost.

Petrel shows no such aversion and is also unfazed by mildly offbeat or potentially distasteful-but-permissible themes, making it the better fit.
